suites.comparison_note: Official frozen CausalPFN checkpoint with native interval APIs vs RF. ATE RF = two-fold AIPW; CATE RF = T-learner. Whole-row RF bootstrap B=100. Native intervals are reported without post-hoc recalibration.

source.title: Proximal ID10 Bootstrap Evaluation — v3
source.verification: Values transcribed from the user-supplied source; models were not rerun by the website.

locators.summary: Pages 8–9 normalized metrics; page 11 pooled coverage; page 15 original-unit appendix

suites.sample_design: 1,000 new ID10 tables and 1,000 retained OOD tables, each n = 500. All 4,000 method calls succeeded. 335 complete OOD method pairs and their historical times were reused; 1,665 pairs were newly evaluated.
suites.split_definition: ID10 restricts and reweights ten native activation-construction subfamilies; it is not the exact training mixture. OOD comprises Cui linear bridge, Qi quadratic and Qi trigonometric mechanisms (343/321/336 tables).
suites.aggregation: Primary metrics normalize each task by its own observed Y sample SD before equal-table aggregation. Pooled OOD Bias/RMSE/Length come from page 9 and Coverage from page 11. Pooled OOD normalized variance and per-split time are not supplied; they are left blank, not inferred from rounded family results.
suites.variance_note: Var((estimate − reference CATE) / SD(Y), ddof=1) across tasks. This is normalized error variance, not fixed-mechanism sampling variance and not bootstrap variance.
suites.hardware: CPU: 16 shared-resource workers; one Torch/BLAS thread per worker; RF n_jobs=1.
suites.timing_scope: Complete point-plus-interval computation including RF B=200 refits; excluding model loading, warm-up, data/oracle generation and I/O. Historical timings are retained. Pooled ID/OOD time is not reconstructed from rounded subgroup data.
suites.comparison_note: Frozen ProximalFM native equal-tail credible intervals vs a custom RF-Proximal-Bootstrap B=200 baseline; this is not a reproduction of published P-learner(RF).
suites.coverage_note: Nominal 95%; all planned outputs valid. Pooled OOD coverage: ProximalFM 94.8%, RF 100%. Qi-quadratic ProximalFM coverage is 86.3%, so the pooled value does not replace family diagnostics.
suites.generator_scope: ID reference CATE uses K=4096 paired Monte Carlo draws, with finite reference uncertainty. OOD reference CATE is analytic.
suites.table_note: NORMALIZED: Bias, error variance, RMSE and Length use each table’s SD(Y). Coverage and time retain original units. Pooled OOD variance/time are not reported. Original-unit appendix is available below.
suites.dgp_note: Page 8: normalized values, with OOD family counts 343/321/336. These are source-reported subgroup results, not new experiments.

source.title: PFN-DiD: third experiment — Reverted DGPs, training protocol and evaluation
source.verification: Values transcribed from the user-supplied source; models were not rerun by the website.

locators.summary: Page 2, Tables 2–3; metric definitions on page 2; runtime on page 6

suites.sample_design: Each of five runs evaluated the same 1,000 ID and 1,000 OOD tables; all 10,000 estimates succeeded. One table per mechanism. S1/S2 are separate trained runs, not independent repeats or an ensemble.
suites.split_definition: Ten ID families and three source-OOD families excluded from adapter training and validation. Upstream TabPFN pretraining exposure is not established.
suites.aggregation: Equal weight per table within each split; reported values copied from Tables 2–3. S1 and S2 remain separate, with no averaging or best-seed selection.
suites.variance_note: Sample variance of cross-table ATT estimation errors, denominator M−1. It mixes sampling variation and error heterogeneity across mechanisms; with one table per mechanism it is not a within-mechanism sampling variance.
suites.hardware: PFN: shared MTT S5000 / MUSA GPUs. RF: eight single-thread CPU workers.
suites.timing_scope: Per-table elapsed computation including preprocessing, transfer/synchronization, nuisance folds and DR scoring or RF fitting. Excludes file reading, loading and warm-up. Different hardware/concurrency; no matched-hardware speedup.
suites.comparison_note: DirectATT S1/S2, PS/OR-DR S1/S2 and RF-DR-DiD are separate procedures. RF uses an analytic difference-in-mean-changes path on no-X tables; no RF bootstrap was run.
suites.generator_scope: Source mechanisms adapted to scalar two-period ATT. Some added-covariate extensions were reverted; not all original paper designs were restored.
suites.coverage_note: Nominal 95%. DirectATT OOD undercoverage is retained; DR methods use clipped propensities and influence-function intervals. Aggregate coverage does not establish per-mechanism calibration.
suites.table_note: Original units · Variance = cross-table error variance (not within-mechanism) · One table per mechanism · Training seeds listed separately · CPU/GPU times are not hardware-matched.
